missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Жертва' is the nominative subject of 'осталась'. 'Эта' is the agreeing feminine form, and 'без помощи' adds the genitive of absence.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Жертву' is the accusative object of 'нашла'; the feminine '-а' shifts to '-у'. 'Единственную' agrees in the feminine accusative.

missions.phrase: Имени этой жертвы никто не знает.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Жертвы' is the genitive showing whose name is meant. 'Этой' is the agreeing feminine genitive form. A natural ownership construction.
Strategic focus: Dative case. 'Жертве' is the dative object of 'помогли', the person who receives help. 'Пострадавшей' agrees in the feminine dative. A core helping construction.
Strategic focus: Instrumental as predicate. 'Жертвой' is the instrumental after 'стал', naming what someone became. 'Обстоятельств' is the genitive plural completing the idiom.

missions.phrase: В этой жертве видна большая боль.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В жертве' uses the prepositional 'жертве' after 'в' to locate emotion within the person. 'Этой' is the agreeing feminine prepositional form.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Жертвы' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'получили'. 'Все' is the agreeing plural form. Good for the feminine plural ending.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural with zero ending. 'Жертв' is the genitive plural after 'несколько'; hard-stem feminines drop the ending. A useful count-of-people construction.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural of animate nouns. 'Жертв' matches the genitive plural because the noun is animate here. 'Всех' agrees in the animate accusative plural.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'О жертвах' uses the prepositional plural after 'о' to mean remembering the victims. 'Войны' is the genitive specifying which ones.
